title: Eukaryotes 18S-V4 rRNA Metabarcoding PCR Protocol for NGS Illumina Sequencing
author: Sarah Romac
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bzucp6sw
materials: PCR reactions are performed using the Taq polymerase Phusion High-Fidelity Master Mix with GC buffer (Thermofisher, Cat No F-532 L) . This Taq has a good proof-reading and its buffer allows amplification of high GC templates. Keep the same annealing temperature as the one is used with the usual 18S-V4 primer set. First test each of your taggeg-primer sets on a positive and a negative control following steps 5, 6, 7 and 8. Then you can perform DNA sample amplification following next steps.

PCR products are quantified using the quantification kit: Quant-iT™ PicoGreen® dsDNA reagent *2000 assays* (Invitrogen, cat nb P7581) and a Fluorometer Plate readerFluorometer Plate reader, following the manufacturer's protocol. Quant-it Picogreen dsDNA kit.pdf

After the preparation of the Pooled Amplicons (and concentration if needed), the final concentration is checked by quantification using Qubit 4 Fluorometer (Invitrogen) with the kit Qubit 1x dsDNA HS Assay (Invitrogen, Thermofisher Scientific cat. No Q33230). MAN0019617_Qubit_1X_dsDNA_BR_Assay_UG.pdf
If possible, check the final Pooled Amplicons quality on a Bioanalyzer using the kit Agilent DNA 1000 (Agilent Technologies, Cat. No 5067-1504). G2938-90014_DNA1000Assay_KG.pdf

Sample loading and electrophoresis conditions : Prepare the loading samples : In a semi-skirted 96-wells PCR plate (like AB-0900 PCR plate), mix 5µL of each sample with 1µL of loading buffer 6x (Thermofisher Scientific, ref R0611). Place solidified gel in the proper orientation (electrophoresis occurs from cathode to anode). Load : - PCR products : 6µL ; - Smartladder 200 to 10 000 bp : 3µL ; (Eurogentec, ref MW-1700-10). Close the caster and connect it to the generator ( Bio-Rad, ref 1645050). Let run the electrophoresis at 110 V for 45 min.

steps.title: Prepare tagged primers
steps.instruction: Order lyophilised tagged primers (e.g., V4f-M8R001, V4f-M8R004, V4f-M8R005) from Eurogentec with RP‑Cartridge Gold purification; under a PCR hood dissolve each primer in TE 1× sterile buffer to a 100 µM stock, vortex briefly and spin, let stand 15 min at room temperature, then prepare a 10 µM working solution by adding 10 µL of the 100 µM stock to 90 µL sterile Milli‑Q water in a labelled 1.5 mL microtube; store both stock and working solutions at –20 °C.

steps.title: Design PCR plate layout
steps.instruction: For each DNA sample (DNA1, DNA2, …) assign a unique tagged‑MID primer; plan triplicate PCR reactions per sample to obtain ≥50 ng total, and include one positive control and one negative control on each semi‑skirted 96‑well plate (e.g., AB‑0900). Record the layout in a PCR‑plate table.

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Using Phusion High‑Fidelity Master Mix with GC buffer, assemble a master mix that will provide 24 µL per well; keep the mix on ice in the PCR hood.

steps.title: Set up PCR reactions
steps.instruction: Dispense 24 µL of the master mix into each designated well, add 1 µL of the appropriate tagged‑MID primer‑template mix (containing ~5 ng DNA template) on the bench; repeat for each of the three replicates per sample and for the controls.

steps.title: Run PCR thermal program
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler for 20–25 cycles (maximum 30) to minimise chimera formation; use the same annealing temperature as for the standard 18S‑V4 primer set.

steps.title: Prepare 1.2% agarose gel
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.2 g agarose (Interchim, ref 31272L) in 100 mL 0.5× TAE buffer (TAE 10×, ThermoFisher, ref 15558042, diluted with Milli‑Q water); heat until fully dissolved, add one drop of Ethidium Bromide (Eurobio, ref GEPBET02AF), pour into a casting tray with combs (Bio‑Rad, ref 1704484), remove bubbles and let solidify for 20 min.

steps.title: Assess PCR products on gel
steps.instruction: Load 5 µL of each PCR product with loading dye onto the 1.2 % gel, run electrophoresis, visualize under UV (e.g., ImageQuant LAZ4000); verify that the negative control shows no band, the positive control shows a clear band, and each sample shows a single band at the expected size (471 bp, noted elsewhere as 427 bp) with no smear. Store all amplicons at –20 °C.

steps.title: Pool triplicate PCR products
steps.instruction: For each DNA sample, combine the three replicate PCR reactions into a single labelled microtube (include sample ID, target, MID number, and date).

steps.title: Purify pooled PCR products
steps.instruction: Using NucleoSpin® PCR Clean‑Up kit (Macherey‑Nagel, cat. 740609.50 or 740609.250), mix 1 vol pooled PCR with 2 vol buffer NT, load onto the column, then elute with 22 µL buffer NE pre‑heated to 65 °C; incubate 5 min at 65 °C, centrifuge 1 min at 11 000 g, collect eluate and store at –20 °C or proceed to quantification.

steps.title: Quantify purified amplicons
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of each purified amplicon (e.g., fluorometric assay) to obtain ng/µL values for downstream equimolar pooling.

steps.title: Prepare final equimolar pool
steps.instruction: Calculate volumes needed to combine all amplicons into a single tube (“Pooled Amplicons”) containing 1 µg total DNA in 30 µL (target concentration >35 ng/µL). If the calculated volume exceeds 30 µL (i.e., concentration <35 ng/µL), reconcentrate the pool using the same NucleoSpin kit before final dilution.

steps.title: Store pooled amplicons
steps.instruction: Aliquot the final pooled amplicon solution and store at –80 °C until shipment.

steps.title: Ship pooled amplicons to Fasteris
steps.instruction: Package the –80 °C frozen “Pooled Amplicons” tube on dry ice and ship to Fasteris SA NGS Services, Chemin du Pont‑du‑Centenaire 109, CH‑1228 Plan‑les‑Ouates, Switzerland. Include in the package (and email to ngs@fasteris.com) the quotation number (Q#####), order form, purchase order, and a Pro Forma invoice.

steps.title: Optional: Ship amplicon plate to GeT‑Biopuces
steps.instruction: Instead of a single pool, keep the triplicate pools in the original semi‑skirted 96‑well plate, seal to prevent evaporation, store at –20 °C, and ship on dry ice to Plateforme GeT‑Biopuces INSA/TBI, Bât 39 – Bio5, 135 Avenue de Rangueil, 31077 Toulouse Cedex 04, France. Include the PCR1 sample file (plate plan and amplicon sizes) and the signed Miseq prestation file, also sent by e‑mail.
